name: GitHub Release
description: Create a bounded GitHub release from an explicit tag, repo, and reviewed notes file.

notes_file.description: Relative path to the release notes file

steps.description: Create the release through GitHub CLI

constraints: Tag, repository, and release notes file are explicit approved inputs
Release notes content is content-hash-bound through notes_file
The command surface is fixed to gh release create with no asset-upload expansion
invariants: No asset upload or delete operation occurs through this recipe
Only structured gh argv is allowed
GitHub CLI auth must be present in the runtime before execution

requires_auth.message: GitHub CLI login is required to create a release.
